description: This file defines a PHP trait 'NormalizerTrait' used in the serialization process within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods for normalizing objects and arrays of objects into arrays, handling model class validation, and ensuring models implement the necessary interface. The trait is intended to be used by serializer classes to standardize object normalization.

methods.name: getModelClass
methods.description: Returns the current model class name being normalized.

methods.name: setModelClass
methods.description: Sets the model class name to be used for normalization.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Retrieves the data (object or array) to be normalized.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Assigns the data to be normalized.

methods.name: normalizeObject
methods.description: Normalizes a single object into an array, ensuring the model class is valid and invoking toArray() on the model instance.

methods.name: normalizeObjectsArray
methods.description: Normalizes an array of objects, converting each to an array format.

methods.name: checkForValidModelClass
methods.description: Validates that the model class implements the 'Normalizable' interface; throws exception if invalid.

methods.name: getInitializedModelInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of the model class, passing constructor arguments if applicable.
